messages.subject: print issue in RStan?
parts:

doing wrong. I wrote a model and it fit OK (I assume), then I
get this:

> print(fit)
Error in quantile.default(chain, probs = probs) :
missing values and NaN's not allowed if 'na.rm' is FALSE

I can't print any of the values,

> print(fit,c("mu"))
Error in quantile.default(chain, probs = probs) :
missing values and NaN's not allowed if 'na.rm' is FALSE

- Bob

messages.author: f53f4ca2c430170d
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] print issue in RStan?
parts:
On Monday, March 23, 2015 at 8:14:28 PM UTC-4, Bob Carpenter wrote:
OK, I figured out what was happening.  I had a generated
quantity that wasn't getting defined.

Is there a way to trap this to let me know what the error is
from RStan?

Does look like there are some options:
> data <- c(-Inf,4,rep(-Inf+Inf,4))
> quantile(data)
Error in quantile.default(data) :
missing values and NaN's not allowed if 'na.rm' is FALSE

> quantile(data, na.rm=TRUE)
  0%  25%  50%  75% 100%
-Inf -Inf -Inf -Inf    4
> data.frame(data, is.na(data), is.nan(data))
  data is.na.data. is.nan.data.
1 -Inf       FALSE        FALSE
2    4       FALSE        FALSE
3  NaN        TRUE         TRUE
4  NaN        TRUE         TRUE
5  NaN        TRUE         TRUE
6  NaN        TRUE         TRUE

It would probably be better to use either 'try' or do some checking on Stan output prior to trying to analyze it if Stan is allowed to return NA/NAN values.

Krzysztof

- Bob
